governing_principle: Strictly pre-origin historical evaluation (zero lookahead / zero future leakage)
description: Series with sparse or low-volume demand suffer from baseline under-prediction; applying downward seasonal shrinkage multiplies negative bias and degrades accuracy. Candidate C applies post-holiday calibration only to series demonstrating sustained volume (>= 35 units in trailing 12 weeks), non-sparsity (<= 50% zero weeks), and holiday surge elevation (MA12 >= MA26).
